_comment: Engine settings from the budget planner. £7.47/week at 30 indices x 15 businesses (£389/yr, $10.16/wk at £1=$1.36). Unit prices measured 27 Aug 2026 against the live account.

serp._note: Standard queue is 3.3x cheaper than live and a batch job never needs live. Depth 100 is the only setting that scores firms ranking below 20 - the laggards an index exists to measure. $0.00465/keyword.

ai._note: Perplexity sonar named real Bristol firms in testing at 1/17th the price of ChatGPT ($0.00591 vs $0.10205). Cross-validate against chat_gpt/gpt-5.6-sol quarterly, not weekly.

local._note: Two sources, because neither alone is adequate. business_listings/search is ONE call per index, aggregates a firm's branches, and is priced per result returned (~$0.00048/result, so ~$0.048 at limit 100). my_business_info is per business ($0.0015) and unreliable for multi-branch chains - it resolved 7 of 18 Bristol firms where the listings sweep resolved 10, and they fail on DIFFERENT firms. The sweep runs first; profileFallback then fills the gaps. reviews (newest-first) is the only source for the 90-day velocity, and is keyed by place_id from whichever source matched.

intent._note: labs/search_intent classifies the whole basket in one call, ~$0.0134 per index. Publishing it is how a reader can check the basket is not all one intent - every Cheltenham keyword came back 'commercial', meaning the Visibility pillar measures one slice of the funnel.

geoGrid._note: Local-pack coverage across a city. radiusM is the third component of DataForSEO location_coordinate and must sit in 199-199999; it is validated, not trusted. The same query 6km apart returns almost entirely different 3-packs, so a firm can look strong in the index and be invisible near its own office. size x size live SERP calls at ~$0.0035 each: 9 points = $0.032 per index. Raise size to 5 ($0.088) for a finer map.

cadence._note: Enrichment (backlinks, ranked keywords, domain rank) is $0.060/domain - 20x the core. None of it moves week to week, so it runs on its own slower cycle.

budget._note: Soft ceiling. collect.mjs prints actual spend per run from the DataForSEO cost field; it does not enforce.
